theme.caption: The same switch as the site footer — change it here, it changes there, and vice versa.

cookies.summaryNotSet: Not set yet (optional cookies active by default)

animations.caption: These options only change the visual side of things. The site's content stays exactly the same, only how it moves on screen changes. If your computer is a bit older (or your browser just has a ton of tabs open), these effects can make browsing feel a little choppy. If that's the case, switching to "Reduced animations" or "No animations" makes the site noticeably lighter, without losing any information.

all.label: All animations
all.description: Default site behavior, with no changes.

reduced.label: Reduced animations
reduced.description: Keeps the site's main transitions, but turns off extra glow and motion effects.

none.label: No animations
none.description: Turns off all of the site's motion, glow, and transition effects.

cursor.caption: The chosen cursor applies to the whole site (including over buttons and links) and is saved in this browser.

language.caption: Choose the site language. Your preference is saved in this browser.
